mapper.select: select T1.resource_id, T1.name, T1.score, T1.algorithm_id, T1.level, T1.specialist_fifth_index_context, T1.next_ids, T2.name as algorithm_name, T2.mode as mode from cr_eval_index_ref T1 left join cr_eval_algorithm_ref T2 on T1.algorithm_id = T2.resource_id where T1.record_id = #{record_id} and T1.level >= #{level}
